verdict.rationale: Databricks documents first-party 'managed MCP Services' hosted on Databricks that external agent clients (Claude, Cursor, MCP Inspector) can connect to, plus discovery/auth flows for calling MCP servers from agent code, and Marketplace listings of MCP servers — this is a genuine official MCP server offering, not just client-side tool use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation that external agent connections to these Databricks-hosted MCP servers work smoothly in practice.
